headline: OpenAI updates GPT-6 Luna with mixed safety-evaluation results
summary: OpenAI's October 29 system-card addendum identifies GPT-6 Luna (October 29) as an updated ChatGPT model, described as more concise and less overly agreeable than the October 7 version. The card assigns the update High capability classifications in cybersecurity and biological/chemical domains and reports 99.91% robustness on its instruction-hierarchy evaluation. OpenAI also reports improvement on four selected under-18 safe-completion evaluations, but mixed or lower comparisons on several HealthBench and MentalHealthBench measures. These are provider-run results; this review did not independently reproduce them or establish safety outcomes in ordinary use.
